summary: BLOQUE 3 (performance + pagination) validated. Backend: 9/9 new BLOQUE 3 tests pass; total regression 49/51 (2 failures are quota-exhaustion side-effects, NOT code regressions). Verified: (1) GET /api/matches returns per-match 'unread' via aggregation - increments after peer message, resets to 0 after POST /matches/{id}/read; (2) GET /api/groups returns member_count+is_member for all seeded groups without N+1; POST /groups/{id}/join reflects is_member=true on next GET; (3) GET /api/groups/{gid}/events returns attendees[] & attendee_count; (4) GET /api/matches/{id}/messages defaults to <=50 in ASCENDING order; ?limit=2 returns <=2; ?limit=201 -> 422; ?before=<created_at> returns strictly older docs; (5) POST message then GET returns the new one in latest set; (6) /api/notifications/counts returns {new_matches:0, unread_messages:0, total:0} after seen+read on all matches. Frontend: login demo1 OK; /app/chats renders chat list with 2 chats; opening a chat shows data-testid='chat-input' present; load-older button NOT shown (chat has <50 msgs — expected: code path exists at ChatDetail.jsx:141 `hasMore && messages.length>=50`). Visibility polling verified: 3 polls in 10s while visible → 0 polls in 12s while document.hidden=true → 2 polls in 10s after visibility restored. compressImage helper wired in EditProfile.jsx:39 and Onboarding.jsx (verified via grep).

minor.issue: Daily me-tinca quota is 20/day per user; running full regression back-to-back exhausts demo1's quota causing test_like_then_reciprocal_match and test_like_amistad_ok_both_have_amistad to 429. Not a BLOQUE 3 regression - fixed by resetting/seeding or spacing runs; also could refactor tests to use fresh accounts.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 1353 lines even after BLOQUE 3 partial split — the endpoint handlers themselves still all live in server.py. Recommend a routers/ package (auth, chat, groups, admin, uploads).

list_matches aggregation pushes ALL messages ({c: created_at}) per match to compute unread; for chats with 10k+ msgs this is memory-hungry. Consider $match created_at > reads_last_read first, then $count.
notif_counts uses the same push-all pattern (line 749). Same optimization opportunity.
get_messages returns docs.reverse() (ascending) — correct. Pagination cursor uses ISO string comparison which works because created_at is always UTC ISO with same offset. Good.
Frontend ChatDetail.jsx uses 12s backoff after 60s idle (verified). BottomNav has visibility gating (line 25).
compressImage helper caps at 1080px @ q≈0.82; used in both onboarding & edit-profile flows.
